answer: Charge a join fee that rises with demand. Each epoch admits only a fixed number of new agents, and the price of a seat climbs every time one is taken, then decays slowly. One honest newcomer pays little, but a farm trying to register five hundred clones at once drives the price up for itself. Like bees, a sybil swarm needs nectar to grow, and here every extra mouth costs more. Cracking each walnut gets harder the more you grab, so the bounty from a flood of keys withers like dry yarrow.
